request.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:KNIGHT

layers.text: Redraw it as another member of the same society in the same blue hood: the hood and its eyes become one big round polished brass diving helmet with one round porthole glowing bright green in its front; beside the helmet is the wide mouth of one huge pale cream conch shell horn held in a cream mitten. No candle and no eyes. Keep the blue cloth, the size, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
